source.definition: Nominal US Treasury collateral, uncleared bilateral repo/reverse repo; general/specified collateral and overnight, <30day, >=30day buckets. Sum six mutually classified buckets per side. Excludes cleared, sponsored, GCF, triparty, TIPS and other-financing series. Not whole dealer balance sheet or regulatory capital.

source.rights: Public NYFed Markets API under preserved NYFed Terms of Use, private research with identifiers/attribution; no confidential dealer-level data, raw public redistribution, credentials or purchases.

signal.mechanism: Joint contraction in private intermediary secured borrowing and lending can proxy deleveraging and tighter dollar intermediation, potentially supporting USD versus RUB. Matched-book closure may occur without asset fire sales, and venue substitution/client demand can dominate; neither a capital-ratio estimate nor a proven cross-border causal effect.
signal.primary: SI long0.9 iff current borrowing total AND current lending total are each strictly below their own values four weekly reports earlier; otherwise cash. Five complete positive-total reports in one schema era required. Exact Decimal sums/comparisons; no training/search.
signal.control: Constant SI long0.9 on identical readiness/calendar. Diagnostic only, cannot be promoted after outcomes.
signal.missing: Missing/null cell masks newest state and any five-report window containing it; no zero fill or older-good fallback. Genuine individual zero allowed, either side's nonpositive total is unready. Malformed/nonfinite/negative financing, duplicate/unknown key or missing entire weekly calendar report fails closed. Four-report comparison crossing July2024 break unready, despite matching selected labels.
